review_decomposition.coverage: exactly one distinct required obligation per atom; exact set equality is mechanically checked
review_decomposition.implementation_admission: all 18 sealed PASS results plus independent read-only trace and corpus verification; any missing or failing atom rejects exact V9
review_decomposition.mechanical_checker: must pass before review launch and again over unchanged bytes after review
reviewer_flow: one fresh fork_turns=none task receives only a control prompt naming the exact Goal objective and waiter directory
the task loads the exact bootstrap skill as control-only, creates its own native Goal, and blocks in the waiter
only after a stable ACTIVE trace does the parent publish exactly one predeclared review atom
the task judges that one atom, completes the same Goal, and returns PASS or that atom's sole fail token
the task and result are never retried, reused, resent, relaunched, replaced, repaired, or selected by best-of
review_decomposition.source_binding: the read-only checker reopens exact V8, failure, skill, recipe, and checker identities; each atom carries one concise semantic projection and the exact V8 digest
review_decomposition.terminal_evidence: each result requires exact one-turn skill-load, ACTIVE, waiter-subject, COMPLETE, token, and task_complete trace with unique task, Goal, turn, nonce, and trace hash

semantic_inheritance.base: exact V8 runtime architecture remains source evidence, not authority
semantic_inheritance.superseding_rule: V9 review_decomposition is the sole architecture-review and implementation-admission rule
